rules.description: Reminder for a known liability minimum payment; does not claim that liquidity is insufficient or that the full statement is due.
rules.trigger: Raw Liability (not predicted recurring) has finite positive minimumPayment and valid YYYY-MM-DD dueDate within 30 Vietnam calendar days from injected asOf; no overdue reminder
rules.severity_logic: urgent when days_until_due<=7, else attention; mirrors existing upcomingObligation urgency
rules.cooldown: proposed 24h per liability/dueDate/state; no current persisted cooldown
rules.suppression: suppresses P4/P5 while active; unknown amount/date or failed source load produces no candidate
blockers: Liabilities are fixture/browser data and are not persisted in SQLite for the DB-backed Home MVP.

rules.description: Known liability payment due soon exceeds verified available liquidity.
rules.trigger: PROPOSED: positive known liability minimumPayment due within 7 VN days AND current-account available balance below due amount; recurring predictions do not qualify as contractual obligations
rules.severity_logic: urgent when due within 2 days, otherwise attention; thresholds require product approval
rules.cooldown: proposed 24h per obligation unless due bucket/severity changes
rules.suppression: suppresses P4/P5; no trigger when any mandatory input is unknown/stale
blockers: No approved due-date/threshold policy or source freshness SLA
Liabilities are mock seed plus client localStorage; no authenticated server snapshot parity
Need define whether savings liquidity is usable and avoid double-counting multiple obligations

rules.description: Jar near its own monthly limit, over it but covered, or has an uncovered negative balance.
rules.trigger: current VN month and set limit; needs_cover when remaining<0; over_limit_covered when spent>limit and remaining>=0; near_limit when limit>0 and spent/limit>=0.8
rules.cooldown: proposed 24h after dismiss; active record remains cached and can reappear on material state change
rules.suppression: suppresses P4/P5; one candidate per jar; resolver picks top N

rules.description: Projected jar exhaustion before monthly cycle end using recent net spending.
rules.trigger: PROPOSED: remaining>0, >=3 active spend days, daily burn>0 and days_to_empty<days_left; fixed-category policy and ingestion completeness must be defined
rules.severity_logic: proposed urgent <=3 days to empty, otherwise attention
rules.suppression: suppresses P4/P5; dedupe with jar_plan_pressure by jar and select strongest state
blockers: Current engine has no recent daily burn feature or ingestion watermark
Archived 7/30-day recipe is not live code; product must approve windows and fixed-category treatment
Server snapshot must include same client corrections and session rebalance data or explicitly exclude it

rules.description: Large category increase versus previous month.
rules.trigger: existing detector: previous>0, current>1.3*previous and delta>=500000 VND; select largest delta
rules.cooldown: proposed once per category/month; reset on semantic state change
rules.suppression: may display with P0/P1 only when top-N policy allows; never displaces higher priority

rules.description: Recurring spending that may merit review; do not assert waste or cancellation eligibility.
rules.trigger: PROPOSED: recurring series from >=3 distinct months plus an approved cost/variance policy
blockers: Recurring inference is not a bill contract and cannot establish leakage or avoidability
Trigger threshold and eligible action absent

rules.description: Goal is off an agreed savings schedule.
rules.trigger: PROPOSED: compare actual contribution against an explicit goal schedule; not target gap alone
blockers: No canonical contribution schedule or reliable savings history
Goal records can live only in client localStorage

rules.description: Surplus after all mandatory obligations and approved buffer.
rules.trigger: BLOCKED until complete obligations and buffer policy yield positive verified surplus; product suggestion only from eligibility engine
blockers: Product eligibility/policy engine missing; high CASA or unallocated balance is insufficient

rules.description: Positive spending reinforcement only after risk evaluation is complete.
rules.trigger: PROPOSED: all eligible set-limit jars under approved safe pace with fresh complete snapshot and no P0/P1 active
blockers: Safe pace policy and complete risk coverage not implemented
Missing/stale jars cannot be interpreted as safe
